mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Tonopah West silver-gold project on private land, Nye/Esmeralda counties, Nevada (~1 km WNW of Tonopah; controls western half of historic Tonopah district). Updated PEA (news Mar 31, 2026; tech report filed May 13, 2026, eff. Jan 4, 2026, Minetech): 11.2-yr mine life; avg 7.1M AgEq oz/yr; mine plan 89.6M AgEq oz (79.6M payable); LOM recoveries 91.6% Ag, 96.3% Au. Base case (US$2,700/oz Au, US$31/oz Ag): after-tax NPV5% US$437M, IRR 28%, payback 3.5 yrs; 1-yr analyst consensus ($4,554/oz Au, $66.90/oz Ag): NPV US$1.55B, IRR 79%. Initial capex US$190M; AISC US$17.44/oz AgEq. Early-production plan: decline/test mining/bulk sampling pending permits (target mid-2027). Silver designated a U.S. critical mineral Nov 2025. No production.

notes: Developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. TSX-V:BRC, OTCQX:BKRRF, Frankfurt:AHZ0. President & CEO Andrew Pollard. 150,000+ m drilled since June 2020. Named to 2026 TSX Venture 50 (share price +273%, market cap +353% in 2025). All economics in USD.
